rule: Target dates are FPA FOD local discovery days. FIRMS acquisitions are converted to America/Los_Angeles dates. Every feature for target day D uses data dated D-1 or earlier.

terrain.availability: Static SRTMGL3 (2000 acquisition), available before every target day.

thermal.availability: FIRMS acquisitions converted to Pacific dates, summed through D-1. The yearly archive mixes near-real-time and later standard-processing rows, so values can differ slightly from what was visible at the time.

weather.availability: NASA POWER daily values for D-1 from MERRA-2 reanalysis, typically published days later. Not available in real time: retrospective only.

history.availability: FPA FOD discovery rates from training years only, leave-one-year-out within training.
